funding.supported_assets_note: Card spends a USD or EUR 'Banking Account' balance topped up by SEPA/USD bank transfer to a personal IBAN, by card from another bank, or by stablecoin deposit on several blockchains (list only in-app). Whether stablecoin deposits are converted at top-up or held as stablecoins is not stated. The crypto wallet is MPC non-custodial (keys not held by COCA); the banking balance is described only as one 'you control' running on unnamed 'regulated payment infrastructure' — custody of the card balance left unknown.

variants.region_label: Global (73 listed residence countries incl. EEA, UK, CH)

eligibility.nationality_restrictions_note: Residence governs: 'you need to select the country of your residence, not the country of your citizenship'.
eligibility.usage_note: Positive list of 73 countries/territories published identically in the Tier System Terms (§1.2) and the ordering article: 41 in Europe (all 30 EEA states plus AD, CH, GB, GI, GG, IM, JE, MC, MD, ME, UA), 18 in Asia/Oceania/Middle East, 5 in Africa, 9 in Latin America. EUR bank accounts (IBAN) are limited to 28 countries (25 EU states — not HR, CY — plus Iceland, Norway and the UK; no EUR account for AD, CH, LI, GI, GG, IM, JE, MC, MD, ME, UA) and require app version 3.0.0 or higher. The United States is not listed. Limits are expressed in EUR and claim capacities in USD.

kyc.stages_note: Verification starts when adding the card product ('Add Products'), before any card is issued: government-issued passport, ID card or driving licence plus proof of address (bank document, utility bill dated within 6 months, government document, lease or employer letter); 'typically up to 20 minutes'. Selfie/liveness not mentioned. The non-custodial crypto wallet itself can be used without verification. 18+ for the loyalty programme.

evidence.title: Tier System Terms & Conditions (help centre; effective 1 Sep 2025, last updated 1 Sep 2026)
evidence.excerpt: Six tiers by COCA stake 0/300/1,000/3,000/10,000/30,000: cashback 1/3/4/5/6/8%, Monthly Claim Capacity $15/25/35/60/140/350, plastic card $5 (three lower tiers) or free, 50% subscription rebate (≤$70), 5% USD APY. Card for residents of 73 listed countries; EUR accounts for 28. No FX, ATM, top-up or delivery fee; no issuer or legal entity named. Appendix: card limits.

scope.note: Global terms; limits in EUR, claim capacities in USD

evidence.contradiction_note: Cashback is 'credited in stablecoins (e.g., USDC, EURC)' to USD/EUR balances in §3.4 but 'paid in USD or EUR' elsewhere. Page 'Modified on 12 Oct' while the text says last updated 1 Sep 2026.

evidence.title: COCA Debit Card Limits (help centre, modified 27 Oct)
evidence.excerpt: Purchase: €30,000 per transaction, per day and per month; €75,000 per 3 months; €100,000 per 6 months; count unlimited for Visa cards. Cash withdrawal: €850 per day, €5,000 per month, 5 per day. Elite members may request a higher limit via Card Details → Visa Card Limits. No fees on the page.

evidence.title: COCA Card (docs.coca.xyz)
evidence.excerpt: Virtual and physical debit card; Apple Pay and Google Pay. 'COCA Virtual Card is free for all tiers'; physical card $5 for Starter, Standard, Standard+ and free for Premium, Premium+, Elite. Same purchase and ATM limits as the help centre; 'Visa Card Limits' menu. No FX, ATM, top-up or monthly fee mentioned; issuer not named.

evidence.title: Banking Account — Overview (docs.coca.xyz)
evidence.excerpt: USD and EUR (SEPA) banking account with personal IBAN; top-up by bank transfer, by card from another bank, or with supported stablecoins on multiple blockchains. 'Zero FX fees on direct currency pairs', 'Zero annual fees', free virtual card. Card availability depends on country of residence. Issuer, licence, KYC and other fees not stated.

evidence.title: Virtual Card and Physical card (help centre, modified 27 Oct)
evidence.excerpt: 'The COCA Card is provided in collaboration with Wirex.' Works wherever Visa/Mastercard are accepted; virtual and physical options; 3D Secure by SMS only. No fee figures.

evidence.title: How do I order a COCA card? (help centre, modified 12 Oct)
evidence.excerpt: Residence country (not citizenship); KYC: passport, ID card or driving licence plus proof of address (bank document, utility bill ≤ 6 months, lease, employer letter); 'typically up to 20 minutes'. Virtual card usable once approved; physical card needs an initial top-up 'equivalent to €50 to cover delivery and card issuance', remainder becomes balance. Same 73-country list as the Tier Terms.
evidence.contradiction_note: The ordering article asks for an initial top-up equivalent to €50 'to cover delivery and card issuance' (remainder stays on the card), while the dated Tier System Terms list a $5 plastic-card fee on Starter/Standard/Standard+ and free on higher tiers. The Terms value is modelled; budget for the €50 top-up when ordering a physical card.

evidence.title: How to top-up the card? (help centre, modified 29 Apr)
evidence.excerpt: Two methods: crypto deposit from an external wallet to the address linked to the card (supported assets and networks listed in-app only) and bank transfer to the account details shown. No fees, minimums, processing times or conversion details stated.

evidence.title: MiCA Regulation and COCA (help centre, modified 13 Jul)
evidence.excerpt: 'COCA is non-custodial', 'Your private keys are not held by COCA'; the wallet 'is not licensed as a MiCA Crypto-Asset Service Provider (CASP)' and is described as generally outside MiCA custodial provisions. Card and payment services run through 'the appropriate regulated payment infrastructure' — provider, regulator and legal entity not named.

evidence.title: What is COCA? (help centre, modified 3 Mar)
evidence.excerpt: MPC non-custodial wallet with a non-custodial debit card (virtual and physical) offered to users in the EEA, the UK and APAC. Describes transactions as fee-free 'including ATM withdrawals up to $250 globally' and says the wallet 'eliminates monthly and foreign exchange charges'. No entity, network or fee schedule.
evidence.contradiction_note: Marketing claims of free ATM withdrawals (≤ $250) and no FX charges are not backed by any fee schedule; the Tier Terms and the limits article state limits only. Fees kept unknown.

evidence.title: Refer a Friend Campaign (help centre; effective 1 May 2026, last updated 26 Oct 2026)
evidence.excerpt: Referrer $20 and friend $10 (USD or EUR) when the new user orders a card, spends ≥ $100 cumulatively and makes ≥ 3 payments at different merchants within 30 days of registering; claimable after 14 days; clawback if the friend closes within 60 days. No publisher or partner programme mentioned.

evidence.title: COCA Welcome Cashback Drop Promo — Terms & Conditions (help centre, modified 2 Nov)
evidence.excerpt: 'The promotion runs from 2 November 2026 to 30 November 2026.' New users registering in the period, KYC completed, located in a card country: 8% on the first three eligible card transactions, capped at $300 of eligible spend ($24 maximum), then the standard 1% or tier rate. Paid to the USD or EUR account.

Second independent read on 2026-11-06 (48 h 39 min after the first) of all 11 evidence pages — every material value confirmed, no page modified since the first read (help-centre 'Modified on' stamps unchanged: Tier Terms 12 Oct, limits 27 Oct, virtual/physical 27 Oct, ordering 12 Oct, top-up 29 Apr, MiCA 13 Jul, What is COCA 3 Mar, Refer a Friend 26 Oct, Welcome Cashback Drop 2 Nov). now itemised as tier bonus + stake part), claims once per 24 h, minimum $1, pending 14 days, expire after 12 months, payout wording still 'stablecoins (USDC, EURC)' in §3.4 vs 'USD or EUR account' elsewhere (contradiction unchanged), USD balance APY 5 % up to the tier cap then 2 % (tier table says '5 %, unlimited' — page-internal inconsistency, §4 governs), no EUR APY, subscription rebate 50 % up to $70 on 0 / 1 / 2 / 2 / 3 / 4 categories, Curve flat 1 % below Premium+ from 2026-04-01, staking locked for the whole membership with a 30-day cooldown, exclusion list identical, 18+; plastic card $5 on Starter / Standard / Standard+ and free from Premium, virtual card free on every tier (Terms + docs.coca.xyz card page); eligibility — the same 73 countries/territories listed by name in the Terms §1.2 and the ordering article, one-to-one match with residence_allowed, United States still absent; EUR accounts limited to the same 28 countries, app ≥ 3.0.0; residence governs, not citizenship; KYC — passport / ID card / driving licence + proof of address (bank document, utility bill ≤ 6 months, government document, lease, employer letter), verification 'up to 20 minutes'; physical card ordered against an initial top-up equivalent to €50 covering delivery and issuance (fee component still not itemised → issuance fee stays 'contradictory' with the $5 Terms figure); limits €30,000 per transaction / day / month, €75,000 per 3 months, €100,000 per 6 months, ATM €850/day, €5,000/month, 5 withdrawals/day (limits article, docs card page, Terms appendix; limits article now adds 'subject to change'); 'The COCA Card is provided in collaboration with Wirex' verbatim, no issuing entity, no COCA legal entity, no regulator named on any page; MiCA article still 'non-custodial', 'not licensed as a MiCA CASP'; 'Zero FX Fees on Direct Pairs' and 'Zero Annual Fees' (docs overview) and 'ATM withdrawals up to $250 globally' (What is COCA) remain marketing statements — FX, ATM, top-up and delivery fees stay unknown; Apple Pay and Google Pay (docs); Refer a Friend $20 / $10, ≥ $100 cumulative, ≥ 3 merchants, 30 days, 14-day claim, 60-day clawback, effective 2026-05-01 / updated 2026-10-26; Welcome Cashback Drop 2–30 November 2026, 8 % on the first three eligible card transactions, $300 eligible spend, $24 maximum, then 1 % or the tier rate, exclusions identical (page now adds that a fully refunded transaction among the first three is replaced by the next eligible purchase). editorial.summary: Non-custodial MPC wallet with a USD/EUR banking account and a debit card 'provided in collaboration with Wirex' (issuing entity not named), available to residents of 73 listed countries including the EEA, UK and Switzerland. Cashback 1% to 8% across six tiers unlocked by staking 300 to 30,000 COCA tokens, but claims are limited to a Monthly Claim Capacity of $15 (Starter) to $350 (Elite). No annual fee; virtual card free, plastic $5 on the three lower tiers. No fee schedule is published: FX, ATM, top-up and delivery fees are unknown despite marketing claims of zero FX and free ATM withdrawals up to $250.
good_for: Residents of the 73 listed countries who want a free virtual card with 1% cashback and no annual fee
Holders of COCA tokens willing to stake them for higher cashback rates and the 50% subscription rebate
Users who value a non-custodial crypto wallet alongside a EUR/USD IBAN account
not_for: Anyone who needs published FX, ATM and top-up fees before choosing a card — none exist
High spenders expecting uncapped cashback: the Monthly Claim Capacity ($15 on Starter) limits what can be claimed each month
Users who require a named regulated issuer: the issuing entity and the COCA legal entity are not disclosed on the pages read
watch_outs: Issuer not named: the card is 'provided in collaboration with Wirex'; the legal entity behind COCA, the e-money/payment provider and the regulator are not stated anywhere read. The MiCA article says the wallet is not a licensed CASP.
Network recorded as Visa from the limits article ('Visa cards', 'Visa Card Limits' menu); marketing text says 'Visa/Mastercard'.
No fee schedule: 'zero FX fees on direct currency pairs' and 'fee-free ATM withdrawals up to $250' are marketing statements; the FX, ATM, top-up and delivery fees are modelled as unknown.

Cashback is nominally unlimited but can only be claimed up to the Monthly Claim Capacity ($15/$25/$35/$60/$140/$350 by tier, +$1 per 100 COCA staked); unclaimed amounts carry over, pending 14 days, expire after 12 months, and are paid in stablecoins/USD/EUR per contradictory wording.

Tier access requires staking COCA tokens that are locked for the whole membership, cannot be partially unstaked and earn nothing; the USD values in the Terms are indicative and move with the token price.

Physical card order requires an initial top-up equivalent to €50 covering delivery and issuance (remainder spendable); the Terms list a $5 plastic fee on the three lower tiers — fee component not itemised.
Payments through Curve earn a flat 1% below Premium+ (from 2026-04-01). The 'What is COCA?' article (March) and the Tier Terms differ on free ATM and FX; the Terms govern and state nothing.
Welcome Cashback Drop (8% on first three transactions, max $24) runs 2–30 November 2026 for new users only.
